payload.lessonGoal: Explain how DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash overcomes the KV cache bottleneck in long-context serving using CED and CSA2 architectures.
payload.learnerAssumption: A curious student with basic knowledge of LLM inference and the role of the Key-Value cache.
payload.centralQuestion: How does DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash drastically reduce memory and compute costs for million-token contexts?

requiredClaims.statement: Large KV caches strain HBM and SSD capacity, constituting the primary bottleneck for long-context deployment costs.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reduces global KV cache footprint to 1/4 and persistent footprint to 1/8 of its predecessor.
The Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture activates only 8B parameters during prefill compared to 16B during decode.

requiredMechanisms.statement: CED projects decoder global KV from encoder hidden states, halving prefill computation for long sequences.
CSA2 utilizes cross-layer KV cache reuse to eliminate redundant storage across Transformer layers.

scenes.teachingGoal: Explain the multi-layered approach to KV cache reduction in DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
scenes.learnerShouldUnderstand: How CED, CSA2, and FP4 quantization work together to shrink the memory footprint.
scenes.mentalModel: A high-efficiency pipeline where data is projected, shared across layers, and compressed to fit in limited memory.

beats.purpose: Establish the problem of KV cache scaling.
beats.narrationDraft: In long-context AI, the KV cache becomes a massive bottleneck, straining hardware memory and slowing down response times.
The Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture activates only 8B parameters during prefill by projecting decoder KV states from encoder outputs.
Compressed Sparse Attention 2 further slashes storage by sharing these global KV entries across multiple Transformer layers.
By quantizing the global cache to FP4 precision, the model fits four times more context into the same memory.

beats.purpose: Explain the impact on persistent storage.
beats.narrationDraft: These optimizations combine to reduce the persistent cache footprint to just one-eighth of previous generation models.

misconceptions.claim: Sparse attention only reduces computation, not memory.
misconceptions.correction: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash uses CSA2 and FP4 specifically to reduce the memory footprint of the KV cache.

evidenceRefs.quote: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash combines cross-layer KV cache reuse in Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with FP4 KV caching. These designs reduce its global KV cache footprint to 890 bytes per token, roughly 1/4 of the corresponding footprint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash.
